note: Network, flow direction and distances: HydroRIVERS (modelled from a 15 arc-second DEM, ~500 m). Where a reach clearly follows an OpenStreetMap river, its line is redrawn on the OSM channel and it carries the OSM river name; elsewhere the HydroRIVERS line is kept (it may be offset from the real river). Dam points are approximate and snapped to the nearest reach.
